applies_to: ABB EQ A41 (direct connected) and A42 (transformer connected) DIN meters whose RS-485 port is set to Modbus.
summary: The A41 and A42 are meters of ABB's EQ A-series. With the RS-485 port set to Modbus they answer function 3/6/16 requests on holding registers whose hex numbers go on the wire as printed. The register layout is the common EQ mapping; quantities a variant does not measure answer with an invalid marker. This map covers energy (total, tariff, per phase, resettable), instantaneous values, I/O, identification, CT/VT settings, resets and the DMTME-compatible block.

addressing.note: Every start register is printed in hex exactly as sent on the bus; the manual says not to subtract 40000 or 1. 5000 hex = 20480 decimal. The example request frame reads 0x5000 with function 3.

source.title: A41/A42 User Manual
source.pages: Protocol settings table pp. 39-40; chapter 9 'Communication with Modbus' (mapping tables pp. 89-99)

notes: Addresses are hex wire addresses. All data is in holding registers: read with function 3 (up to 125 registers), write with 6 or 16.
Multi-register values put the most significant byte in the high byte of the lowest register, so 32-bit and 64-bit values are ABCD.
Quantities a given article does not measure still answer, filled with FFFF (unsigned) or the largest positive value (signed).
Left out: resettable reactive import/export (5534, 5538 hex). The manual prints kWh as their unit, so the unit cannot be taken from the table as printed.
Instantaneous power registers are signed 32-bit with 2 decimals (about +/-21 MW maximum); the manual points to the DMTME block for larger systems, but its power rows are left out here (see below).

Left out: date/time and power-outage time (packed byte fields), the 64-bit error/information/warning/alarm flag strings, harmonics arrays, load-profile resets, DST start/end packed fields, the DMTME energy rows printed as 'Wh*100' / 'VArh*100', the DMTME CT/VT ratio rows, and the selector-based log and load-profile readout.
I/O registers exist only on articles with matching inputs/outputs. Per-phase registers for phases a variant does not have return the invalid marker.

Left out: the DMTME-block active and reactive power rows (102E-103C hex). This manual prints them Unsigned while the A43/A44 manual prints the same rows Signed, so their type is uncertain. Use 5B14-5B22 for signed power.

integration.summary: Select Modbus for the RS-485 port in the meter's settings menu, then read holding registers with function 3 at the hex addresses as printed (0x5000 for total active import). Multi-register values are high word first; energies are 64-bit with 2 decimals.
integration.enable: In the meter's settings menu open the RS-485 communication page, choose Modbus (instead of EQ-Bus), then set baud rate, address and parity.
quirks: Addresses are hex wire addresses; no 40001 or minus-1 offset.
Readable range is 0x1000-0x8EFF; reads outside it return exception 2.
Unsupported quantities return FFFF / 7FFF... instead of an exception.
Writes to a listed-but-unsupported register are silently ignored; read back to confirm.
setup: Function codes 3, 6 and 16; broadcast works with 6 and 16.
gotchas: Modbus runs only on the RS-485 port; the IR side speaks M-Bus or EQ-Bus.
In transformer-connected meters (A42) the energy registers hold primary values: the CT/VT ratios at 0x8C04-0x8C0A are already applied.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
